title: Understanding the Graph
text: The graph shows two curves labeled A and B. The horizontal axis represents the regularization parameter lambda, and the vertical axis represents error.

title: Interpreting Curve A
text: As lambda increases, curve A decreases. What does this suggest about the relationship between lambda and the error represented by curve A?

title: Interpreting Curve B
text: As lambda increases, curve B increases. What does this suggest about the relationship between lambda and the error represented by curve B?

title: Bias and Variance
text: In the context of regularization, increasing lambda typically reduces model complexity. How does this affect bias and variance?

title: Identifying Curve A
text: Based on the behavior of curve A as lambda increases, what type of error does it represent?
choices: (A) is the Test Error and (B) is the error due to $${Bias}^2$$.
(A) is the error due to $${Bias}^2$$ and (B) is the error due to Model Variance.
(A) is the error due to Model Variance and (B) is the Training Error
(A) is the error due to Model Variance and (B) is the error due to $${Bias}^2$$.

hintAnswer: (B) is the error due to Model Variance
